changeinfo.changes:
Ver. 1.02 Change Log
  • Added English, Korean, and Chinese (Traditional/Simplified) translation.
  • Added a new quest, “The burning beast”.
  • Fixed a bug where the ship sometimes went beyond the map.
  • Fixed the overflowing texts.
  • Added “Iron ladder”, “Iron pole”, “Iron platform”, “Iron door”, and “Iron ship decoration”
  • Fixed a bug where the character wouldn’t throw “Sand ball”, “Soil ball” and “Stone ball”.
  • Fixed a bug where the character sometimes came back to life with zero HP.

Ver. 1.01 Change Log
  • Added a new quest, “Defeat the green dragon”.
  • Adjusted the speed of acquiring items.
  • Adjusted the recovery time from damage.
  • Added a row to the initial items box.
  • Extended the time available to pick up debris items.
  • Extended the max limit of items stuck up to 99.
  • Adjusted the strength of bone hummer and stone hummer.
  • Adjusted the timing appearance of Griffins.
  • Refined the collision detection of Griffins’ whirlwind
  • Adjusted the appearance of ladder tutorial in Jail Island.
  • Fixed a bug where water flow sometimes stops for seconds.
  • Changed ‘Show Control’ to ‘Control’.
  • Added ‘Move Setting’ - Switches function between directional key and left stick.
  • Added ‘Jump for UP’ (the character won’t jump when she moves up).
  • Added ‘Voice Setting’ (On/Off voice).
  • *‘Show Control’, ‘Move Setting’, ‘Jump for UP’ , and ‘Voice Setting’ can be selected from ‘Control’ in menu screen.
